room.purpose: The page ground, the sticky rail at 90% with backdrop blur, the icon-button face, the scrollbar track.

console.purpose: The face of every section panel, the outline button and the hero lede plate.

well.purpose: Recessed displays: the wall board, the mission clock, the operator plate, the downlink monitor, every text field.

seam.purpose: All panel borders, dividers between rows and grid cells, the rail rule.

seam-strong.purpose: The heavier stroke on controls: outline buttons, text fields, the scrollbar thumb.

lamp.purpose: Primary ink: headings, the display name, row titles, control text.

lamp-soft.purpose: Secondary ink: descriptive prose, nav links, labels.

lamp-dim.purpose: Tertiary ink: readouts at rest, tool lists, tags, notes, placeholders.

go.purpose: The live signal: GO rows, the ticking clock, LOCKED and OPEN states, STAFFED lamps, focus, caret, selection, the one primary button.

go-ink.purpose: Text on a phosphor button; byte-identical to Well.

legend.purpose: The single current marker (ON CONSOLE, the active period) and transitional ACQUIRING / SENDING states.

fault.purpose: Form validation errors, NO SIGNAL, FAULT. Nothing else.

display.purpose: The operator's name over the portrait. Used once.

headline.purpose: Panel headings in the legend strip. CAPCOM hook runs 44px / 34px; downlink and credential titles 30px / 26px.

title.purpose: Row titles inside a panel: console discipline, flight record, mission-log role (26px / 24px). Systems-board groups at 19px.

legend.purpose: The role line under the display name; wall-board system names at 19px / 17px with 0.01em tracking.

body.purpose: Mission-log summary, hero lede, contact body; 58 to 68ch measure.

body-small.purpose: Console briefs, record descriptions, skill lists, highlights (15px, line-height 1.5); 62 to 70ch. Notes step to 14px / 13px.

control.purpose: Button text; the rail callsign at the same weight with 0.08em tracking.

label.purpose: Nav links, form labels, text links (0.06em), footer links (14px), open mobile menu (18px).

readout.purpose: Every value in a legend strip or right-hand column: counts, periods, the clock, GO and ON CONSOLE (11px, 500, 0.08em), SIGNAL and CHANNEL states, form errors. Never a sentence.

readout-small.purpose: Tool lists under a console brief, tags under a record, the wall-board domain column, the location beside the callsign.

shadows.name: panel-face
shadows.purpose: Every .panel: a hairline of light on the top edge, a dark edge beneath, a low drop that only reads at the bottom.

shadows.name: well-recess
shadows.purpose: Every .well: an inset top shadow so a display sits below the console surface.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The only authored easing: Tailwind ease-out override, Framer ease array, lamp-on.

motion.name: lamp-on
motion.value: lamp-on 520ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both (opacity 0 to 1, brightness 0.6 to 1.8 to 1)
motion.purpose: A wall-board row lighting during the GO poll.

motion.name: flicker-on
motion.purpose: A GO / ON CONSOLE legend catching twice before it holds.

motion.name: go-poll
motion.purpose: The one composed moment: rows light in sequence on load.

motion.name: hero-enter
motion.value: opacity 0 to 1, y 14px to 0, 0.8s ease-out, delays 0.05s to 0.4s
motion.purpose: Hero blocks fading up on load.

motion.name: power-on
motion.value: opacity 0 to 1, brightness 0.5 to 1.6 to 1, 0.7s ease-out, times [0, 0.4, 1], once at 30% in view
motion.purpose: Only the consoles list and the downlink monitor.

motion.name: downlink-swap
motion.value: opacity 0 to 1, brightness 1.6 to 1, 0.5s ease-out; exit opacity 0
motion.purpose: Crossfade when a new meme lands.

motion.name: control
motion.value: filter, background-color, border-color 200ms ease-out; active translateY(1px)
motion.purpose: Every button and link: hover brightens, press nudges 1px.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation: none; opacity: 1; scroll-behavior: auto; Framer initial=false
motion.purpose: Everything renders lit and static; the clock still ticks.

narrative.overview:
The site is a dark flight-operations room. The operator stands in the foreground; the platform he keeps up is the wall board behind him, and each system he runs answers GO in turn. A control room says competence without a superlative: every discipline has a console, every console has a callsign, every row has a readout. The world refuses the category defaults it replaced (a centred name over a glow, skill chips, project cards, a big-number metrics slab) and the retired white resume page.

The ground is grey-green in three depths, never pure black: the room farthest back, console panel faces on it, recessed display wells sunk into those. Ink is warm lamp white in three steps. Light is scarce and meaningful: one phosphor green is the live signal and appears only where something is actually running or GO; one backlit amber marks the single current item, ON CONSOLE; one fault red is for errors and lost signal. Density is high but ruled: sections are panels, panels hold ruled rows, rows end in a right-hand mono readout column.

Structure is panel joinery rather than cards. Every surface meets its neighbour at a 1px seam; panel faces carry a hairline of light on their top edge and a dark edge beneath; wells carry an inset top shadow so a screen reads as set into the console. Motion is lamp-on: the wall board rows light in sequence on load, a legend catches twice before it holds, and the two panels that earn an entrance power on with a brightness overshoot. Everything else is lit on arrival.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-only: one scheme, `color-scheme: dark`, no light theme and no toggle.
Three-depth grey-green ground (room, console, well) with 1px seams; no cards, no floating surfaces.
Phosphor green appears only on live states; amber appears only on the one current marker.
Three typefaces with strict jobs: Barlow Condensed tracked caps for display and controls, Barlow for prose, Martian Mono for every readout.
One authored motion moment (the GO poll) plus two PowerOn entrances; hover brightens, never lifts.
The person leads the first viewport; the work follows as ruled records, never as a metrics slab.

rules.name: The Live-Only Phosphor Rule
rules.body: Phosphor green means something is running right now. It lights a GO row, a ticking clock, a LOCKED signal, an OPEN channel, a STAFFED lamp, a focused field, or the one primary action; it never colours a heading, an icon at rest, a decorative rule or a static label (a text link and its arrow may turn phosphor together on hover).

rules.name: The One Amber Rule
rules.body: Amber is the current marker. Exactly one thing on the board is ON CONSOLE, and amber appears there, on the active mission-log period and on transitional states (ACQUIRING, SENDING) that are about to resolve to phosphor. It is never a second accent.

rules.name: The Dark-Only Rule
rules.body: There is one scheme. The ground is grey-green (never pure black) and `color-scheme: dark` is declared; no `prefers-color-scheme: light` branch exists and none should be added.

rules.name: The Readouts Are Never Sentences Rule
rules.body: Martian Mono carries values: a count, a timestamp, a callsign, a period, a state word, a comma-separated tool list. If it has a verb, it is prose and is set in Barlow. The one mono line that approaches a sentence (the certification name on the hero plate) is a credential title, not copy.

rules.name: The Engraved Caps Rule
rules.body: Barlow Condensed is never set in sentence case. Every use is uppercase with tracking between 0.01em (display) and 0.08em (labels), tightening as the size grows.

rules.name: The Panel Joinery Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are joined, not stacked. A panel sits on the room with a seam and a top hairline; a well sits inside a panel with an inset shadow. There are no cards, no floating containers and no hover lift anywhere.

rules.name: The One Authored Motion Rule
rules.body: The page has one composed moment: the GO poll, where wall-board rows lamp on 150ms apart starting 700ms after load (a 520ms opacity and brightness overshoot on `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`) and each legend flickers on (420ms, stepped). The hero blocks fade up 14px over 0.8s on the same ease, staggered 0.05s to 0.4s. Only two blocks power on when scrolled into view (the consoles list and the downlink monitor: 0.7s, brightness 0.5 to 1.6 to 1, once, at 30% visibility). Control transitions are 200ms brightness, background or border changes. Under `prefers-reduced-motion` every entrance renders fully lit and static and the clock still ticks.

dos: Do keep the three ground tones in order: Room behind, Console panels on it, Well recesses inside them, every join a 1px Seam.
Do put a mono readout at the right of every legend strip and at the right of every list row at lg; it holds a value (count, period, state, callsign), never a sentence.
Do reserve Phosphor Green for live states and the one primary button per view, and Backlit Amber for the single current marker or a transitional state about to resolve.
Do set every Barlow Condensed string uppercase and tracked, tighter as it gets larger (0.01em display, 0.04em headings, 0.08em labels).
Do make hover a brightness or colour change (110% / 125% brightness, border to Lamp Dim, text to Phosphor) and press a 1px downward nudge.
Do render every entrance fully lit and static under `prefers-reduced-motion`, and keep the clock ticking.
donts: Don't add a light theme, a theme toggle or a `prefers-color-scheme: light` branch; the room is dark-only and declares `color-scheme: dark`.
Don't use cards, floating containers or hover lifts, and don't add drop shadows beyond the panel-face and well-recess vocabulary; depth is joinery, not stacking.
Don't colour a heading, an icon at rest, a rule or a static label in Phosphor Green, and don't introduce a second accent beyond amber and fault red.
Don't set prose in Martian Mono or set Barlow Condensed in sentence case.
Don't add a metrics slab, big-number counters or superlative headlines; figures live inside the lines of a record.
Don't author new entrance choreography or scroll-triggered motion beyond PowerOn on a display that earns it; the GO poll is the page's one composed moment.
Don't use pure black or a stock Tailwind radius (8px and up); the ground is grey-green and the only radii are 3px and 6px.
